description: The bar chart illustrates two sets of data: Accuracy (%) and Token Count. The horizontal axis represents different methods, labeled as CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT. The vertical axis on the left measures accuracy in percentage, ranging from 70% to 100%, while the vertical axis on the right measures token count, ranging from 0 to 800. The accuracy data is represented by bars in various colors: red for CoT, orange for CoD, green for CCoT, and blue for CoUT. The token count data is represented by bars in the same colors. The highest accuracy is observed in the CCoT method at 91.19%, while the lowest is in the CoD method at 80.89%. The highest token count is in the CCoT method at 676.85, and the lowest is in the CoUT method at 354.46. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
